svg.aria-label: qtrade's real current wiring, expanded: main.rs resolves strategy-declared underlying names to that day's real tokens once at startup, then feeds each decoded event independently to Cache and to ExecutionEngine, which never connect to each other. ExecutionEngine gates strategy-submitted orders (RMS, validate) before forwarding them to the separate SimExchange matching engine, but applies market events to SimExchange with no gate at all; SimExchange's exec reports are the only thing that reaches Portfolio and CostModel. EventDispatcher reads Cache and wakes the strategy's on_book/on_trade only for subscribed instruments, though ctx.book() can read any filtered instrument regardless of subscription. ControlDispatcher receives ctx.subscribe() as a borrowed reference to EventDispatcher and forwards it in the same call, without either dispatcher storing a reference to the other. The strategy calls back into ExecutionEngine directly to submit orders and to read Portfolio and CostModel, and into Cache directly for book/refdata reads. After the loop ends, main.rs reads the same ExecutionEngine instance directly to write orders.log, fills.log and report.txt.
